# Agent Device Protocol (ADP)
# https://agentdevices.org/

> ADP is an open protocol for AI agents to own and use real devices: a laptop, a camera, a screen in the kitchen.
> Requests are signed with Ed25519, access is approved on the device itself, and no cloud or relay sits in the middle.

Status: v1, experimental. Companion to AMP (messages), AID (identity), AAP (UI actions) and AFP (files).

## Rules

- A device is optional. An agent with no device is complete.
- An agent can own many devices and is active on at most one.
- A device has zero or one owner. The device's signed answer is the truth.
- The person at the device has the last word. Camera, microphone and speaker are off until granted there. Ownership changes wait for approval there. A controller cannot turn off the in-use sign.
- No cloud, no relay. Device and controller talk directly.
- Fixed operations only. No remote shell, no arbitrary files, no remote code.

## Roles

- Device: owns the hardware and the local grants. Answers signed requests.
- Controller: acts for agents: keys, inventory, the active device, liveness. One process can serve many agents.

Devices either answer on HTTP or open their own WebSocket connection to the controller.

## Exchange

1. Controller gets a one-use challenge from GET /v1/challenge. It expires after 30 seconds.
2. Controller signs {type:"invoke",id,challenge,to:deviceKey,capability} and posts it to /v1/request. Discovery uses type "discover".
3. Device verifies the controller pin, target and challenge, and consumes the challenge.
4. Device signs a response with the same id and challenge and to:controllerKey. The controller verifies it.

A packet is JSON with two unpadded base64url strings, body and signature. The Ed25519 signature covers the UTF-8 bytes of ai-maestro-device/1, one NUL byte, then the exact body bytes.

## Capabilities

- device.health: empty object. Local grant: ownership. Activation: any.
- camera.snapshot: empty object. Local grant: camera and working visible indicator. Activation: active.
- display.text: text, up to 4096 UTF-8 bytes. Local grant: display.text. Activation: active.
- display.image: mime (image/jpeg or image/png), standard base64 data, decoded maximum 256 KiB. Local grant: display.image. Activation: active.
- speaker.say: text, up to 500 UTF-8 bytes. Local grant: speaker.say. Activation: active.
- custom.OWNER.ACTION: installed by the device owner on the device, with an explicit local grant, off by default.

## Not done yet

Live media over device-opened connections. macOS, mobile and embedded devices. Hardware acceptance on real camera and audio devices is in progress.
